annotations.title: Read an Atlas Node or Section

description:
Read a complete Node (bare id: identity, hierarchy, Hook, and
every Section; relationship occurrences are omitted),
one Section ('node-id#section-slug'), one Decision record
('decision:<decision-id>'), or one exact glossary definition
('term:<key>').

address.description: A bare node id; 'node-id#section-slug', the slug read off a Node's sections, a Card claim's sources, or a Link's occurrence (slugs are not guessable); or 'decision:<decision-id>'; or 'term:<key>'.

expected_revision.description: A prior payload's 'coherence'; 'revision_changed' refuses a moved Release.
